sources.title: Exponential readme
sources.locator: Exponential agent dev platform; Quick start; Self-hosting; Status
sources.finding: Documents native desktop/iOS/Android and web clients, a server CLI daemon, own-machine coding sessions, worktrees, issue boards, child sessions, PR/merge train and self-hosted core. eDE, UI libraries and voice are separate components/stages.

sources.title: Exponential apps/site/src/content/docs/docs/using/sessions.mdx
sources.locator: Start a session; Several issues at once; Watch and steer; Review and merge; Agents and triggers
sources.finding: Documents Claude Code/Codex own-login sessions, parallel children, remote device selection, own worktrees, PR creation, Merge PR/Merge stack, opt-in Yolo automatic merge and scheduled/event-triggered team agents.

sources.title: Exponential apps/desktop/crates/eagent/src/local/mod.rs
sources.locator: Module Run contract lines34-38; LocalAgent new/start; native login methods
sources.finding: LocalAgent starts installed Claude/Codex over ACP and supports sending, permissions, interruption and native login. This is coding-harness integration, not a model alias.

sources.title: Exponential apps/site/src/content/docs/docs/using/issues.mdx
sources.locator: Issues documentation: statuses, issue detail and linked work
sources.finding: Documents product-owned issues with fields, status and linked sessions/PRs.

sources.title: Exponential apps/ios/Exponential/UI/Issue/DiffRendering.swift
sources.locator: Diff line rendering and old/new code rows
sources.finding: iOS diff rendering builds visible rows from proposed patch code text, with added/removed styling and line numbering, not only file counters.

sources.title: Exponential apps/ios/Exponential/UI/Issue/DiffFileCard.swift
sources.finding: The issue diff file card reaches patch rendering, establishing a product UI entry for proposed file content.

sources.title: Exponential apps/site/src/pages/privacy.astro
sources.locator: Data collected: Diagnostics and First-party usage statistics
sources.finding: Policy discloses default diagnostics and server aggregate usage counters as separate collection. Client diagnostics have a per-device Send diagnostics control; the policy does not promise that it stops server aggregates.

sources.title: Exponential apps/web/src/lib/observability/preference.ts
sources.finding: Web diagnostic preference defaults true unless exp.sendDiagnostics is off; changing it is a local per-device preference.

sources.title: Exponential apps/web/src/lib/observability/client.ts
sources.finding: Only loads client monitoring SDK when server diagnostics are enabled and device preference is on; toggling off closes the SDK.

sources.title: Exponential apps/web/src/components/account/privacy-section.tsx
sources.finding: Settings Account exposes the per-device diagnostic toggle.

sources.title: Exponential LICENSE
sources.finding: Main application source is Apache-2.0; third-party components keep their separate licenses.

sources.title: Exponential pricing
sources.locator: Free, Team and Self-hosted price cards
sources.finding: Hosted Free is ongoing for3 seats; Team price shown is EUR12 per seat/month billed yearly. Self-hosted is free on user hardware with no plan limits and no first-party mobile push. No USD monthly paid price is inferred.
